What do you pack?

Running at a customer site
05 · Secondary packing

Pouch Bundling Machine

Counts your finished small pouches and seals them into one master bag. An inclined pouch conveyor feeds the counting unit, and the whole machine runs from a Delta touchscreen.

Feeding
Inclined cleated conveyor lifts pouches up to the counting unit
Counting
Preset pouches per bundle, set on the touchscreen (10 in the video)
Bagging
Forms, fills and seals the master bag from a film reel
Screen
Pouches per minute, total production counter and current pouch count
Printed film
Eye-mark (photocell) can be switched on or off
Sealing
Digital temperature controllers for the sealing jaws
Safety
Emergency-stop button · stainless-steel body
